personal_info.name: Rohan Mehta
personal_info.summary: Offensive security engineer focused on web and network penetration testing, red teaming, and vulnerability research. Comfortable across Burp Suite, Metasploit and custom tooling.

experience.title: Security Research Intern
responsibilities: Performed black-box penetration testing of client web applications using Burp Suite, reporting findings against the OWASP Top 10
Built proof-of-concept exploits for authentication bypass and IDOR issues in staging environments
Triaged SIEM alerts in Splunk and wrote detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques
Automated recurring vulnerability assessment scans with Nmap and Nessus, cutting manual triage time in half

projects.name: CTF Exploit Toolkit
description: Wrote a Python toolkit for binary exploitation challenges, automating ROP-chain construction
Reverse-engineered stripped binaries with Ghidra to recover control flow and identify overflow primitives

projects.name: Home Lab Red Team Range
description: Built an intentionally vulnerable Active Directory lab for red teaming practice
Documented lateral-movement and privilege-escalation paths end to end
